name: Aaliyah
source:
The Main Character meets her working in a convenience store and does not recognise her at first, having not seen her since she was a young teen. After geting the hint that he and his old mate Omar used to hang with her brother, he however immediately identifies her. 

Aaliyah is a beautiful young woman and quickly becomes MC's girlfriend (one of them in any case). Aaliyah's feet are very dexterous, she once managed to unbutton the protagonists pants with her feet while they were seated at the dinner table and then proceeded to give him a footjob, all the while keeping up a conversation.

As MC was close friends with Aaliyah's brother, Jamal[footnote]Jamal is often mentioned but does not appear physically in the novel so he has no character entry.[/footnote], he was often over during their teens. One particular incident still colours Aaliyah's father's perception of MC. They were watching a movie late one night and one by one drifted of to sleep, including MC, when the young Aaliyah got curious (she had a teen crush on MC) and opened MC's pants to check out his dick. She had just started to feel him up when her father woke up and saw what she was doing and in a fit of anger threw out MC and grounded Aaliyah for a month! He still blames MC for the incident. 

Aaliyah's parents are Jada and Jerome.
